retries.retryAccounting: Nominal amounts exclude retries; application failures can multiply agent/verifier/judge spending up to 3 in this scenario; OpenAI SDK retries may multiply main-agent request spending again, and Voyage retry attempts up to 5. Failed timed-out calls may still be billed.

limits: These are total-token scenario assumptions, not runtime caps. Agent maxSteps=99 and variable tool context/output can exceed them. Current phase has no provider access. A later paid campaign needs approved budget and enforceable usage limits before execution.
